title: nf-core/phyloplace pipeline - params.phyloplace_input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.phyloplace_input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

queryseqfile.errorMessage: FASTA file with query sequences: extension .fa, .fna, .faa or .fasta, optionally gzipped (.gz). xz is not supported.

refseqfile.errorMessage: Multiple sequence alignment of the reference sequences: extension .aln, .alnfa, .alnfaa, .alnfna, .mfa, .fa, .fna, .faa, .fasta, .ph, .phy or .phylip, optionally gzipped (.gz). xz is not supported.

refphylogeny.errorMessage: Newick file with the reference phylogeny: extension .newick, .nwk or .tree, optionally gzipped (.gz). xz is not supported.

hmmfile.errorMessage: HMM profile file: extension .hmm, optionally gzipped (.gz). xz is not supported.

model.errorMessage: Phylogenetic model to use in placement, see EPA-NG documentation.

alignmethod.errorMessage: Method to use for aligning: 'hmmer', 'clustalo' or 'mafft'.

taxonomy.errorMessage: Optional tab-separated taxonomy file: extension .tsv or .tax, optionally gzipped (.gz). xz is not supported.

reftreename.errorMessage: Optional name of the reference tree this row places onto. Rows sharing a name are summarised jointly, in addition to individually, and must share the same reference phylogeny.
